opportunities.name: Country macro snapshot email
opportunities.description: For a given country, look up GDP, growth and population on World Bank data, get capital and currency from Wikipedia, then draft an email to a recipient summarizing the macro snapshot.
steps: Open World Bank data site and search for {country}
Open the country page and read GDP (US$), GDP growth % and population with year
Search Wikipedia for {country} and read capital and currency (with ISO code)
Set Body = 'Hi {recipient_name}, {country}: GDP US${gdp} ({year}), growth {growth}%, population {population} ({year}); capital {capital}, currency {currency} ({code}).'
Send or save the draft (the user clicked Discard each time)

opportunities.name: Gutenberg book reading-log note
opportunities.description: For a given book title, find it on Project Gutenberg, get the author's life dates from Wikipedia, and add a 'Read:' note with the author, release date and download count.
steps: Open the matching book result; note the author, release date and download count
Search Wikipedia for {author} and note their birth and death years
Type 'Read: {title} by {author} ({birth}-{death}), Gutenberg since {release_date}, {downloads} downloads' and press Enter
